I verified each repository I'm answering from at its pinned commit (tldraw `5590d14d…`, query `46d7f02f…`, react `3a717e42…`, router `3dee5b2e…`). Note: `redux-thunk` is not present in the index at all — I did not answer from it.

Grounded findings: `fetchCache.ts` stores `null` (the "this failed" placeholder) in an `LruCache` keyed by URL that has no delete; `FontManager` and `useLocalStore`'s `objectURLCache` keep the rejected/null per-object promise forever; `useImageOrVideoAsset.resolve` bails on `previousUrl.current === url`; `Editor.deleteAssets` fire-and-forgets `assets.remove?.()` and `Editor` deletes an asset whose re-resolution failed. The contract lives in query's `retryer.ts` (failing attempt as its own pausable/cancellable object) and in react's / router's explicit three-state resolution types.
